hooks.command: if root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" && [ -f "$root/.claude/hooks/block-destructive.sh" ]; then exec bash "$root/.claude/hooks/block-destructive.sh"; else echo "BLOCKED: .claude/hooks/block-destructive.sh not found under this checkout's git root, so the command is refused rather than run unguarded." >&2; exit 2; fi

if root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" && [ -f "$root/.codex/hooks/check-patch.sh" ]; then exec bash "$root/.codex/hooks/check-patch.sh"; else echo "BLOCKED: .codex/hooks/check-patch.sh not found under this checkout's git root, so the patch is refused rather than applied unguarded." >&2; exit 2; fi
